Privacy · Ads · Platform

Social Interactions Control

A globally launched ad control extending Facebook's social-interaction transparency to Instagram and Accounts Center.

Project typeProduct Design
ContributionUI/UX Design Lead
Year2024
CompanyMeta
01

Overview

When a user likes a brand page that is running an ad, Facebook may surface that social interaction to friends. At the time, users could manage the control on Facebook but not Instagram. The work expanded the control to Instagram and integrated it into Accounts Center so people could manage settings across Meta products from one place.

02

Problem

The experience needed to give people a clear, defensible privacy control while scaling across Facebook and Instagram—and potentially future platforms—without introducing unnecessary screens or cognitive load.

03

Challenge

Use existing platform components, satisfy privacy and policy requirements, support users inside and outside Accounts Center, and create a structure that could scale as more profiles and products were added.

04

Alignment

The work required close collaboration across Facebook and Instagram design, privacy, legal, product and engineering. Multiple flow directions were explored before converging on a compact profile-based pattern with clear status and a bottom-sheet interaction.

05

Solution

The final experience kept the user grounded in a single setting, made account-level status visible, and reused established architecture rather than creating a bespoke control. I partnered with legal on compliance and defensibility and worked directly with engineering through dogfooding and quality-control sessions.
